operationName: Ecuador Internal Armed Conflict / Estado de Excepción
heroHeadline: Noboa Extends State of Emergency as US Treasury Sanctions Manta Cocaine Network
heroSubtitle: President Daniel Noboa extended Ecuador's state of emergency 30 more days across 10 provinces and three cantons on August 14, 2026, citing 238,404 emergency calls logged in five weeks. Days later, the US Treasury sanctioned 15 individuals and companies plus 10 fishing vessels tied to a Manta-based cocaine network supplying the Sinaloa Cartel and CJNG. Gang violence continued unabated: three children were killed in a Guayaquil home invasion on August 14, and four alleged Los Lobos members died in a Los Choneros raid in Babahoyo on August 16. Ecuador has posted Latin America's highest homicide rate for three consecutive years, with roughly 132,000 people internally displaced.
